$ curl -s /tenant/tenants?limit=3
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Yutang",
      "settings_json": "{\"tier\":\"pro\"}",
      "status": "active",
      "tenant_key": "yutang"
    },
    {
      "id": 4,
      "name": "Acme",
      "status": "active",
      "tenant_key": "acme"
    }
  ],
  "has_more": false
}

$ curl -s -X POST -d '{"tenant_key":"acme","name":"Acme","status":"active","settings_json":"{\"tier\":\"team\"}"}' /tenant/tenants
{
  "id": 4
}

$ curl -s -X DELETE /tenant/tenants?tenant_key=acme
{
  "archived": true
}

$ curl -s -X POST -d '{"skill_key":"go-review","version":1,"target_version":3}' /tenant/skills/rollback
{
  "from_version": 1,
  "id": 77,
  "skill_key": "go-review",
  "version": 3
}

$ curl -s -X POST -d '{"user_key":"user-three","email":"user-three@example.test","display_name":"User Three","role":"member","status":"active"}' /tenant/users

  "id": 3
}

{
  "archived": true
}
